title: S-90/S-91 calendar FE remediation — date/timezone filters, states/retry, route map, deep-link, Add Event
status_decision: SAATHI-286 remains In Progress. It is NOT moved to Testing: its assigned criteria include TC-285-08 (Playwright 5 widths x light/dark) and the v2 DoD requires native build + native Vitest, all of which cannot execute in this sandbox (recorded below). Independent Codex QA must run them.

mandatory_fixes.1_registry_test: features/student/screens.test.ts updated to include S-90/S-91 in the exact-match expected set (assertions strengthened, not weakened).
mandatory_fixes.2_date_filters: S-90 From/To date inputs (labelled, aria-invalid/aria-describedby), Clear button, user-scoped persistence via CalendarService.setFilters; validateDateRange(from,to) → from_after_to/invalid_date; invalid range shows message and falls back to all-dates without dropping events.
mandatory_fixes.3_timezone: S-90 IANA timezone <select> (TIMEZONE_OPTIONS), persisted; zonedToUtcIso() converts wall date+time→UTC via Intl offset (runtime-tz independent); localDateKey/localTime prove boundary (e.g. 09:30 Asia/Kolkata → 04:00 UTC, same local day).
mandatory_fixes.4_states_retry: loading/empty/success/partial/error via deriveStatus; partial banner + 'Retry failed sources' calls retryFailed (retry-only-failed; healthy SourceResult objects preserved by identity).
mandatory_fixes.5_source_routes: SOURCE_ROUTE map → canonical /s-NN screens; fixtures updated; 'Go to source' navigates to a real registered screen.
mandatory_fixes.6_deeplink_privacy: resolveDeepLink ownership-aware; missing and unauthorized render an identical 'isn't available' state (no existence disclosure).
mandatory_fixes.7_add_event: S-91 real Add Event workflow: Title, Date, Time, Type (PERSONAL_EVENT_TYPES), typed validation, Cancel/Back, Add to calendar.
mandatory_fixes.8_persist: addPersonalEvent validates→persists via service (ls-cal-personal-<user>); appears on S-90 via calendarLoaders; survives reload; user-scoped.
mandatory_fixes.9_preserved: privacy redaction, ownership, source-filter persistence, 44px targets, light/dark tokens, responsive shell preserved.
mandatory_fixes.10_tests: calendar.test.ts extended (unit/integration); Playwright browser gate deferred to CI (cannot build/serve app here).
